size_basis: L x W x H mm, set by flow_graph/param/reactor_design.py (X-MFG-31)
solids_note: two solids: the vessel chain (plinth, flanges, tube, jacket, branches, preheater) and the catalyst-bed envelope with its support grids, which sit at their running clearances inside the tube bore and are not welded to the pressure part; both closed and manifold

tube.construction: node design: DN50 Sch 40 SA-106 B, L_bed + 400 (A-M-156 / X-MFG-31); the alloy follows duty section 3 - 316L per API 941 (AQS-REV-H2-001 section 5); the SA-106 B row predates it (hold, WORK_ORDER W12)

flanges.rating: ASME B16.5 Class 600 (Group 1.1 at the 250 C design)

jacket.service: DN100 thermal-oil jacket, exotherm to Q3 (node design)

design_pressure.basis: node design t_ok; wall geometry per the node, alloy per duty section 3

bed.basis: purchased-bed envelope per plan rule 6 (Cu/ZnO/Al2O3 pellets, CTC2020_CZA class); the node V_bed_L is the authority

a_ves.basis: reported from the model bed envelope against the node V_work_L; no residence time is derived - the duty section 2 claims no holdup and a fixed bed is not a liquid holdup (A-VES)

material.basis: duty section 3: synthesis 50 bar a, 250 C (study); 316L per API 941 (AQS-REV-H2-001 section 5); above 200 C with H2 partial pressure no carbon steel; CA 0 mm (AQS-STD-001 rule)
